stemMarkdown: A train passes a pole in 6 seconds with a speed of 54 km/h. How long is the train?
solutionMarkdown: To find the length of the train, we first convert its speed to meters per second: $$\text{Speed} = \frac{54 \times 1000}{3600} = 15~\text{m/s}$$ Using the formula for distance (distance = speed × time), we can find the length of the train. The time taken to pass a pole is given as 6 seconds: $$	ext{Length of Train} = 15 \times 6 = 90 \, 	ext{meters}.$$
